title: Volve field Daily Drilling Report DDR-TEST-00077 — wellbore not published in this release
source_system: Equinor Volve / public DDR release — Volve field Daily Drilling
excerpt:
00:00 - 00:15: L/o first casing joint
00:15 - 00:45: R/u power roller system
00:45 - 01:30: POOH with 4 casing joints using clepo protectors. No practical way of using clepo, started to use regular pin protectors
01:30 - 04:00: POOH with 10 3/4" CSG from 670 m to 383 m Average 8,8 joints/hr.
04:00 - 04:30: Observed gain in TT. Closed annular preventer and installed FOSV. No pressure in well. Investigated gain.
04:30 - 04:45: Opened BOP and monitored well on trip tank, static.
04:45 - 05:45: Removed FOSV and pulled 1 joint and removed slips to look into rotary table. Continued investigation.
05:45 - 07:00: RIH, closed annular and installed FOSV. Monitored pressure in well, 0 bar. Continued troubleshooting.
07:00 - 09:15: Continued investigation of TT gain drains on rig floor. Found 6" drain line blocked and diverted through a 2" line to rig's drain system. 2" line too small to handle heavy rain, causing overflood in the diverter which again caused gain in TT. Opened annular preventer and monitored well on TT. Meanwhile performed maintenance on drawworks.
09:15 - 09:30: Performed TBT prior to continuing pulling casing
09:30 - 10:45: POOH with10 3/4" x 9 5/8" casing from 383 m to 246 m. Average 11 joints/hr.
10:45 - 11:45: Changed to 9 5/8" handling equipment
11:45 - 13:45: POOH with 9 5/8" casing from 246 m to surface. Average 10 joints/hr.
13:45 - 14:00: Performed TBT for r/d casing equipment
14:00 - 15:30: R/d handling equipment
15:30 - 15:45: Performed TBT for m/u cutter BHA
15:45 - 16:15: P/u and m/u 13 3/8" cutter assy to 5 1/2" DP
16:15 - 16:30: RIH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from surface to 140 m. Unable to pass casing hanger with 12 1/4" taper mill
16:30 - 17:30: M/u TDS. Attempted to work past restriction 20 RPM 5knm.
17:30 - 17:45: POOH w/ cutter BHA to surface
17:45 - 19:00: Removed slips and installed master bushing. Inspected and gauged mill and stab. Taper mill gauged slightly bigger than 12 1/4". B/o and l/d 12 1/4" taper mill and 12

Performed TBT for RIH with new BHA

RIH w/ cutter BHA on 5 1/2" DP from 140 m to 841 m. Avg RIH speed 700 m/hr.
M/u TDS, filled pipe, 400lpm/33bar. Trapped 25 bar behind IBOP and recorded free rot. Torque at 100 RPM 4 KNM.
Cut 13 3/8" casing at 839 mmd, 80-100 RPM 400 LPM 37 bar. SPP dropped, positive indication of cut.
Flowchecked well, 200ltr gain over 15 min due to open valve from pit 10 to TT. Closed valve. Flowchecked well for 10 min, static.
Established circulation 300 LPM. RIH slowly and tagged cut at 839 mmd. 70 cm window length.
